resourceProfile.assessment: Four common technical IDs across all 21 remaining locales, 36 systematic entries across German, Simplified Chinese, Swedish and Polish; eight focused terms across eleven candidates; full Ohm, juice and mod-range scopes in German. Prior screening supplied additional context. Evidence confirmed from fresh effective-runtime snapshot. German shows repeated severe wrong-sense translations of current, power, nicotine base, volume and target instructions across multiple calculators, plus stale mod-range meaning. Selected by breadth and severity, not queue priority. Full independent critique covered 1115 canonical entries and 11 explicit route metadata records, plus optional labels and runtime assembly. Canonical English, German glossary, current JSX, relevant knowledge base and independent native manufacturer references were available.
limitations: Comparative model screening, not exhaustive assessment or a mathematically established global ranking.
Model critique is not competent human review or maintainer approval.
No browser visual review or source edits performed in this independent pass.
Read all dictionary scope and route metadata; source English leaks recorded separately, not a complete application hard-coded-string audit.
Stylistic variants such as Spule/Wicklung were not mass-rewritten; findings focus on meaning, grammar, stale source and technical distinctions.
Other locales retain existing behavior for the newly optional localization hooks.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation metadata and all 101 canonical correction signatures verified; typecheck passed; 573 tests in 85 files passed. Optional Wire Wizard suffix is explicitly supported by parity validation; a negative regression test confirms missing required messages still fail. Complete IIS and Cloudflare builds passed: 64 route cases, 39 IIS rules, 737 generated links across 10279 HTML files, and 64 Cloudflare artifact route cases. Browser checks passed for 15 German routes, three catalog editors, five battery placeholders, Ohm/Wire Wizard sentence assembly, balanced generated HTML, three desktop/mobile layouts and 12 English routes. Calculation API fixtures isolate rendering. Independent implementation review passed; human review remains pending.

linguisticCritique.summary: Reviewed all 1115 canonical entries and 11 route metadata records. Corrected 109 display entries including eight optional messages and seven runtime argument mappings whose sentinel text is unchanged. Corrections span 42 recurring issue groups over three bounded iterations. Localized decimal formatting and valid symbols were preserved.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent German human review performed; machine-draft notice remains visible.

publicationAuthorization.summary: User explicitly requested full review, improvement, commit, push and deploy, then asked to continue.
